title: An authenticated WebSocket client that sends one invalid frame kills the bot process: dashboard sockets get only a 'close' listener, and the ws library emits 'error' on a protocol violation

evidence.note: addClient registers only ws.on('close'); no 'error' listener on any dashboard socket
every authenticated upgrade goes through addClient
receiverOnError emits 'error' on the WebSocket for any invalid frame (unmasked client frame, bad opcode, oversized payload); an EventEmitter 'error' with no listener throws

evidence.ref: node ws-frame-crash.js <repo>/node_modules/ws (scratch folder outside the repo (Node 22.16.0 by absolute path; no src/ import, no .env, no data/, no live DB; loopback 127.0.0.1 only); WebSocketServer noServer with a connection callback that adds only a 'close' listener, as addClient does; raw client sends one unmasked text frame after the 101)
evidence.note: output: server process EXITED code=1 :: RangeError: Invalid WebSocket frame: MASK must be set

sibling_sites_checked: Every server-side WebSocket in src/api (only the dashboard clients via addClient); the client-side anti-rug and DEX provider sockets with the same missing error listener are AUD-ANTIRUG-002. A browser WebSocket always sends valid masked frames, so this needs a non-browser client holding a valid session cookie (key holder, or a cookie taken from plain-http traffic, AUD-API-007).
severity_rationale: S2 STRAND: the impact is the same process exit as AUD-API-008 (every exit monitor and anti-rug stop until a restart), but it needs a valid session first, which bounds who can trigger it.
recommendation: Add ws.on('error', ...) that logs and terminates that socket in addClient (and a wss 'error' handler); same process-level policy decision as AUD-API-008 (OD-6). Phase 24 together with AUD-API-008.
